comparison.objective: Mount a grinding wheel safely on a bench grinder; candidate calibrates proximity-switch positions.
comparison.physical_skill: Wheel/flange alignment, arbor seating, nut fastening, and damage avoidance versus partial screw release and feedback-guided sensor sliding.
comparison.success_condition: Wheel stack must be correctly oriented, seated, tightened, and safe for rotation; candidate requires two retained sensing endpoints.
comparison.reason: Shared fastening is generic. The record tests coaxial wheel assembly and clamping, not mounted-component registration from proximity feedback.
